title: Vault Fundamentals
intro: **Where challenges run.** Only inside the student's own namespace `students/{user}`, their own database `app_{user}`, their own fork and their own app slot (one per student, `/srv/apps/{user}`). Nothing writes to the shared `secret/` mount outside `secret/students/{user}/`. Challenges use fresh names (`buddy-{user}`, `c2-app`, `capstone-*`) rather than the labs' roles and policies, so redoing one never breaks another or a lab. Secret *values* are never logged or scored: only paths, counts and states. Triggers here: `shell:`, `bao:` (an OpenBao audit-log event for the student's entity or namespace, read by the audit event adapter), `forgejo:`, `verify:` (`secret_exists`, `policy_attached`, `resource_state`).
